summary_en: 10,000k shares (1.88% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired for up to ¥30.0B via ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchases between 2026/08/07 and 2026/09/18. Price ceiling not disclosed. Stated reason: capital-efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast, Revision to Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase), and Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Shizuoka Financial Group disclosed on 2026/08/06 its decision to acquire up to 10,000k treasury shares for a maximum of ¥30.0B via ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchases during the period 2026/08/07 through 2026/09/18. The acquisition represents 1.88% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), calculated from the disclosed ex-treasury base of 530.86M shares as of 2026/06/30. No price ceiling per share was stated in the filing. The company cited capital-efficiency improvement as the buyback rationale. The announcement was issued concurrently with upward revisions to FY2027 (ending March 2027) earnings guidance (operating profit raised ¥15.0B to ¥167.0B; net income to parents raised ¥10.0B to ¥115.0B) and an increase in the dividend forecast from ¥98.00 to ¥108.00 per share, reflecting improved net interest margins driven by higher lending balances and Bank of Japan rate hikes.
